# BPM / Laws+ compatibility patch - common/government_types
# Generated by tools/build.py. Do not rename: the zzzzzzzzzz_ prefix keeps
# these files last in the ASCII order the game resolves conflicts by.

# gov_absolute_empire
REPLACE:gov_absolute_empire = {
	transfer_of_power = hereditary
	male_ruler = "RULER_TITLE_EMPEROR"
	female_ruler = "RULER_TITLE_EMPRESS"
	male_heir = "RULER_TITLE_PRINCE"
	female_heir = "RULER_TITLE_PRINCESS"
	possible = {
		is_domain_alliance_gov = no
		has_law = law_type:law_monarchy
		NOT = { is_subject_type = subject_type_crown_land }
		has_law = law_type:law_advisory_body
		has_law = law_type:law_no_separate_hog
		country_has_voting_franchise = no
		has_gov_regency = no
		OR = {
			country_tier = hegemony
			country_tier = empire
			c:HAI ?= this
			c:DAI ?= this
			c:MEX ?= this
			AND = {
				c:KOR ?= this
				has_variable = KOR_korean_empire_declared
			}
		}
		NOR = {
			has_variable = orleanist_restoration_var
			has_variable = legitimist_restoration_var
			c:ITA ?= this
			c:IBE ?= this
			c:PLC ?= this
			c:YUG ?= this
		}
		country_is_not_united_kingdom_overlord = yes
		country_is_not_united_kingdom_subject = yes
	}
	on_government_type_change = {
		change_to_hereditary = yes
	}
	on_post_government_type_change = {
		post_change_to_hereditary = yes
	}
}

# gov_colonial_administration
REPLACE:gov_colonial_administration = {
	transfer_of_power = presidential_elective
	male_ruler = "RULER_TITLE_GOVERNOR_GENERAL"
	female_ruler = "RULER_TITLE_GOVERNOR_GENERAL"
	possible = {
		has_gov_regency = no
		is_domain_alliance_gov = no
		has_law = law_type:law_presidential_republic
		NOT = { has_law = law_type:law_colonial_administration }
		OR = {
			is_subject_type = subject_type_colony
			is_subject_type = subject_type_dominion
		}
		OR = {
			AND = {
				AND = { exists = c:NET is_subject_of = c:NET }
				AND = { exists = c:DEI c:DEI = ROOT }
				is_subject_type = subject_type_dominion
				AND = { exists = c:UNL is_subject_of = c:UNL }
			}
			AND = {
				exists = c:SPA
				is_subject_of = c:SPA
				is_subject_type = subject_type_colony
				is_country_type = colonial
				top_overlord = { NOT = { is_country_type = colonial } }
				any_primary_culture = {
					has_discrimination_trait_group = heritage_group_european
				}
				NOT = {is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_europe}
			}
			AND = {
				has_variable = senegal_subject_var
				is_subject = yes
			}
			AND = {
				has_variable = niger_subject_var
				is_subject = yes
			}
			AND = {
				has_variable = ethiopia_subject_var
				is_subject = yes
			}
			AND = {
				has_variable = zanj_subject_var
				is_subject = yes
			}
			AND = {
				has_variable = congo_subject_var
				is_subject = yes
			}
		}
	}
	on_government_type_change = {
		change_to_presidential_elective = yes
	}
	on_post_government_type_change = {
		post_change_to_presidential_elective = yes
	}
}

# gov_constitutional_empire
REPLACE:gov_constitutional_empire = {
	transfer_of_power = hereditary
	male_ruler = "RULER_TITLE_EMPEROR"
	female_ruler = "RULER_TITLE_EMPRESS"
	male_heir = "RULER_TITLE_PRINCE"
	female_heir = "RULER_TITLE_PRINCESS"
	possible = {
		is_domain_alliance_gov = no
		has_law = law_type:law_monarchy
		NOT = { is_subject_type = subject_type_crown_land }
		has_gov_regency = no
		country_has_voting_franchise = yes
		OR = {
			country_tier = hegemony
			country_tier = empire
			c:DAI ?= this
			c:MEX ?= this
			AND = {
				c:KOR ?= this
				has_variable = KOR_korean_empire_declared
			}
		}
		NOR = {
			has_variable = orleanist_restoration_var
			has_variable = legitimist_restoration_var
			has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_answers_to_legislature
			c:PLC ?= this
			c:UNL ?= this
			c:YUG ?= this
		}
		NOT = { has_law = law_type:law_semi_constitutional }
	}
	on_government_type_change = {
		change_to_hereditary = yes
	}
	on_post_government_type_change = {
		post_change_to_hereditary = yes
	}
}

# gov_constitutional_kingdom
REPLACE:gov_constitutional_kingdom = {
	transfer_of_power = hereditary
	male_ruler = "RULER_TITLE_KING"
	female_ruler = "RULER_TITLE_QUEEN"
	male_heir = "RULER_TITLE_PRINCE"
	female_heir = "RULER_TITLE_PRINCESS"
	possible = {
		is_domain_alliance_gov = no
		has_law = law_type:law_monarchy
		NOT = { is_subject_type = subject_type_crown_land }
		has_gov_regency = no
		NOR = {
			has_law = law_type:law_autocracy
			has_law = law_type:law_oligarchy
			has_law = law_type:law_technocracy
			has_law = law_type:law_military_junta
			has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_answers_to_legislature
			AND = {
				OR = {
					has_law = law_type:law_appointed_by_hos
					has_law = law_type:law_no_separate_hog
				}
				has_law = law_type:law_advisory_body
			}
		}
		OR = {
			country_tier = kingdom
			c:HAI ?= this
			c:ITA ?= this
			c:IBE ?= this
			AND = {
				c:MON ?= this
				has_variable = king_sounds_better
			}
			c:PLC ?= this
			c:UNL ?= this
			c:YUG ?= this
		}
		country_is_not_dual_or_triple_monarchy_subject = yes
		country_is_not_united_kingdom_overlord = yes
		country_is_not_united_kingdom_subject = yes
		NOT = { has_law = law_type:law_semi_constitutional }
		NOT = { has_variable = KOR_korean_empire_declared }
	}
	on_government_type_change = {
		change_to_hereditary = yes
	}
	on_post_government_type_change = {
		post_change_to_hereditary = yes
	}
}
